title: "MKW Stats"
format: 
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
# library(emojifont)
library(plotly)

options(
  reactable.theme = reactableTheme(
    color = "#D2DDF9",
    backgroundColor = "#0c2461",
    borderColor = "#0c2461",
    stripedColor = "#113388",
    highlightColor = "darkgoldenrod",
    style = list(fontSize = "11px"),
    searchInputStyle = list(
      width = "100%", 
      borderRadius = "0px",
      backgroundColor = "#4976E9", 
      fontColor = "#D2DDF9",
      "::placeholder" = list(color = "#0c2461"))
  ))
```

```{r}
if (!file.exists("drivers.csv")) {
  library(rvest)
  library(readr)
  
  raw_stats <- read_html("https://www.mariowiki.com/Mario_Kart_World") |> 
    html_elements(".wikitable.spinoff.mk") |> 
    html_table() 
  
  kart_driver <- raw_stats |> purrr::pluck(9)
  
  driver_names <- kart_driver[1, ] |> 
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = NULL, values_to = "name") |> 
    purrr::pluck(1) |> 
    str_to_lower()
  
  driver_stats <- kart_driver[2:9, ]
  colnames(driver_stats) <- driver_names
  
  kart_names <- str_replace(driver_names, "driver", "vehicle")
  kart_stats <- kart_driver[12:30, ]
  colnames(kart_stats) <- kart_names
  
  extra_stats <- raw_stats |> purrr::pluck(10)
  extra_stats <- extra_stats[2:4, ]
  colnames(extra_stats) <- kart_names

  drivers <- driver_stats |> separate_longer_delim(driver, ", ")
  karts <- kart_stats |> separate_longer_delim(vehicle, ", ")
  extra <- extra_stats |> separate_longer_delim(vehicle, ", ")
  
  write_csv(drivers, "drivers.csv")
  write_csv(karts, "karts.csv")
  write_csv(extra, "extra.csv")
  
} else {
  drivers <- read_csv("drivers.csv")
  karts <- read_csv("karts.csv")
  extra <- read_csv("extra.csv")
}
```

## row 2

```{r}
if (!file.exists("all-combos.csv")) {
  
  special_combo <- drivers |> 
  filter(str_detect(driver, "\\*")) |> 
  cross_join(extra, suffix = c("_driver", "_kart")) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    c(starts_with("speed"), starts_with("acceleration"), starts_with("weight"), starts_with("handling")),
    names_to = "stat", names_pattern = "(.*)_.*"
  ) |> 
  summarise(value = sum(value), .by = c("driver", "vehicle", "stat")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value)

  all_combo <- drivers |> 
  filter(!str_detect(driver, "\\*")) |> 
  cross_join(karts, suffix = c("_driver", "_kart")) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    c(starts_with("speed"), starts_with("acceleration"), starts_with("weight"), starts_with("handling")),
    names_to = "stat", names_pattern = "(.*)_.*"
  ) |> 
  summarise(value = sum(value), .by = c("driver", "vehicle", "stat")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |> 
  bind_rows(special_combo) |> 
  mutate(across(c("driver", "vehicle"), ~ str_remove_all(., "\\*")))
  
  write_csv(all_combo, "all-combos.csv")
  
  all_combo_weights <- all_combo |> 
    summarise(
      driver = str_flatten_comma(unique(driver)),
      vehicle = str_flatten_comma(unique(vehicle)),
      .by = c("speed", "acceleration", "weight", "handling")
    )
  
  write_csv(all_combo_weights, "all-combo-weights.csv")
  
} else {
  all_combo <- read_csv("all-combos.csv")
  all_combo_weights <- read_csv("all-combo-weights.csv")
}
```

### col 1 {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: All Combos
reactable(all_combo,
  striped = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, wrap = FALSE, 
  compact = TRUE, pagination = TRUE, searchable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 20,
  defaultColDef = colDef(headerClass = "dashboard-tbl-header")
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: Distinct Combos
reactable(all_combo_weights |> select(driver, vehicle, everything()),
  striped = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, wrap = TRUE, 
  compact = TRUE, pagination = FALSE, searchable = TRUE,
  defaultColDef = colDef(headerClass = "dashboard-tbl-header"),
  columns = list(
    driver = colDef(name = "driver", minWidth = 130, align = "center"),
    vehicle = colDef(name = "vehicle", minWidth = 130, align = "center"),
    speed = colDef(name = "speed", maxWidth = 80, align = "center"),
    acceleration = colDef(name = "acceleration", maxWidth = 80, align = "center"),
    weight = colDef(name = "weight", maxWidth = 80, align = "center"),
    handling = colDef(name = "handling", maxWidth = 80, align = "center")
  ),
  )
```

#### row 2

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  inset: 10,
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(data, {
      x: combo_stat_1,
      y: combo_stat_2,
      fill: "gold",
      stroke: "gold"
    }),
    Plot.tip(data, Plot.pointer({
      x: combo_stat_1,
      y: combo_stat_2,
      channels: {driver: "driver", vehicle: "vehicle", speed: "speed", acceleration: "acceleration", weight: "weight", handling: "handling"},
      fill: "#0c2461",
      stroke: "gold",
      lineWidth: 20,
      textOverflow: null
    }))
  ]
})
```
